release_notes.en_US: Unifies percussion editing with piano-roll rectangles and real note lengths, synchronizes in-game key names for drum kit, hand drum, cymbal, and note blocks, and fixes canonical-drum misclassification plus silent fallback for unmapped GM drum pitches. Downloads currently use GitHub.
release_notes.zh_CN: 打击乐编辑统一为钢琴卷帘式矩形音符并显示实际时值；同步架子鼓、手鼓、钹及音符块的游戏键名；修复正式鼓轨误判和未映射 GM 鼓键静默回退。当前下载暂时使用 GitHub 链路。
